transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function for the Rust 1.96 target body.

Adapted the inherent mutable slice receiver to an explicit dst: &mut [T] parameter; the executable target body remains the single call spec_clone_from(dst, src), and the helper now executes the default clone loop.

Replaced the whole CloneFromSpec::spec_clone_from boundary with a source-shaped equal-length-prefix and idx loop, retaining only the lower per-element Clone::clone_from effect and TrivialClone copy specialization.
Recorded the TrivialClone copy path through copy_from_slice_impl as a lower specialization boundary; equal-length behavior is supplied by the generated precondition and the executable default loop.
Preserved the source Clone dispatch surface in the Verus signature and recorded Destruct/drop effects in the lower Clone/copy-path boundary.
Defined the local slice_cloned_from vocabulary as sequence equality for the generated clone-from-slice postcondition.
